Shot C, segment 1 of 2, of ONE continuous take inside the same ruined gothic castle great hall. Low angle close-medium shot looking up at Jialing. On the altar the brass lantern's flame gutters violently in a wind that moves nothing else. A massive broken stone pillar stays fixed at the right edge of the frame, with a row of flickering candelabras on the right side, fixed throughout the entire shot. Jialing wears the same black robe and carries the same brass lantern throughout. In the final stretch of this segment the camera settles into a perfectly still hold for the last two seconds. Color grade: chiaroscuro, extreme low-key, cold steel-blue, moonlit rim on her hair, abruptly overexposed to pure white by the light blast at the end, film grain.
